name: Mediterranean Lamb Chops with Tomatoes, Bell Pepper, Olives & Feta
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Preheat a large ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the lamb chops dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season both sides with spices.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add lamb chops and pan-fry until browned, flipping once, 4-6 minutes (the chops will not be cooked all the way through).
While the lamb is cooking, peel, halve, and slice onion lengthwise into thin wedges.
Trim, seed, and slice bell peppers into thin strips.
When the lamb is browned, remove skillet from heat and add the onion and bell pepper, nestling them around the chops.
Place skillet in the oven and roast until the veggies are fork-tender and chops are cooked through, 6-8 minutes more. Remove skillet from the oven.
Meanwhile, halve and slice tomatoes into 1-inch thick wedges; place in a medium bowl.
Halve olives and add to the bowl with the tomatoes.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
When the chops are done, transfer to a clean plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil.
Add tomatoes, olives, and parsley to the skillet and toss to combine. Return skillet to the oven and roast until tomatoes are warmed through, about 4 minutes. Remove from the oven.
To serve, divide the veggies and lamb chops between plates. Top veggies with feta and enjoy!
author: Mealime
